rule Suspicious_Webshell_Filename {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common webshell file names and paths"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $webshell_path = "/var/www/html/.shell.php" nocase
        $dot_prefix = "." within (10) of "/var/www/html/"
    condition:
        $webshell_path or $dot_prefix
}

rule Suspicious_Webshell_Filename {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common webshell file names and paths"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:

        $dot_prefix = "." within (10) of "/var/www/html/"
    condition:
        $webshell_path or $dot_prefix
}
